_comment: Who this show is. Every script and page reads its name, links, and art text from here, so a fork edits this file instead of hunting for strings.
name: The Deepgram Changelog
description: The Deepgram developer changelog, read back to you every Tuesday. Breaking changes first, then launches, then everything else that shipped the week before, with a link to the docs for every item. Voiced start to finish by Deepgram Flux TTS.
author: Deepgram DevRel
_cadence: How often an episode comes out: weekly (Sunday to Saturday), biweekly, or monthly. release_day is the weekday it publishes, at least two days after its window ends. python3 scripts/cadence.py recommends one for your feed.
_attribution: A 'Voiced with Deepgram Flux TTS' credit in the site footer and the feed description. Set it to false to remove both.
